_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Sètz lo Jogaire {player_id}, jogant {num_rounds} torns de Jòc de l'Ultimatum Iterat.
Avètz ${pool} per partejar aquest torn entre vos e lo Jogaire {other_id}.

Proposant:
  - Faites una oferta: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Se acceptada → Obtengatz $(pool - X), l'autre jogaire obteng $X
  - Se rebutada → Tots dos obtenèm $0
  - Exemple: [Offer: $3]  o  'Me semblètz just. [Offer: $5]'

Responsaire:
  - Decidissètz sus l'oferta amb [Accept] o [Reject]
  - Exemple: 'Aquò sembla rasonable. [Accept]'
            'Trop injust. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Ronda {round_number} comença ! ---
Jogaire {proposer_id} es lo propositor, Jogaire {responder_id} es lo responder.
round.offer: Ronda {round_number}: Jogaire {proposer_id} ofèrta ${offer} a Jogaire {responder_id} (en gardant ${keep}).
round.accepted: Jogaire {responder_id} a acceptat ! Ronda {round_number} ganhs: Jogaire {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Jogaire {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Novèls totaus: Jogaire 0: ${total_0}, Jogaire 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Jogaire {responder_id} a refusat l'ofèrta ! Ronda {round_number} ganhs: Ambedos jogaires +$0. Totaus demòran: Jogaire 0: ${total_0}, Jogaire 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Lo proponent deu far una ofèrta utilizant lo format [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Lo montant de l'ofèrta deu èsser un entièr valid.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Lo jogaire que respond deu o [Accept] o [Reject] l'ofèrta.

outcome.win: Lo jogaire {winner} a ganhat amb ${winner_total} total contra ${loser_total} del jogaire {loser}.
